sloka: तस्य जाजृम्भमाणस्य वक्त्रं पातालसन्निभम् ।ददृशे मेरुशृङ्गाग्रे दिवाकर इवोदितः ।। ६.६०.५९ ।।।।
transliteration: tasya jājṛmbhamāṇasya vaktraṁ pātālasannibham ।dadṛśe meruśṛṅgāgre divākara ivoditaḥ ।। 6.60.59 ।।।।

translations.english: As Kumbhakarna woke up he appeared like the time spirit at the time of dissolution of the universe like a rainy cloud at twilight as if seeking to consume all beings.
